Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Horizon Data's architecture team asked for a consolidated capability pack covering our SAML/OIDC support, SCIM provisioning behaviors, RBAC/admin controls, and audit/retention options. Specifically they want:

- Clear diagrams of SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated SSO flows and support for OIDC (authorization code + PKCE).
- Certificate rotation and metadata endpoints for SAML.
- SCIM provisioning: supported attribute list, bulk provisioning options, delta sync, and max throughput.
- RBAC: built-in role primitives, delegated admin, and examples for tenant scoping.
- Audit logs: retention, export formats, and real-time webhook/event hooks.
- Private deployment considerations (VPC/on-prem) and any differences in admin controls.

Can you provide the capability pack and a short answers document by EOD Tuesday? Also, if you can include a test tenant or sandbox for Horizon to validate SCIM syncs, that would speed evaluation.

Regards,
Claire

Horizon Data Trust

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Wu <claire.wu@horizon-data.com>

Subject: Re: Request: IAM capability pack & clarified answers

Aisha / Neha — draft technical responses below; I'll assemble into the capability pack PDF and attach SCIM examples. Sending as inline for quick review.

--- SAML & OIDC
- We support both SAML 2.0 (SP and IdP-initiated) and OIDC (Authorization Code + PKCE).
- For SAML: metadata endpoints available (SP metadata URL), automated cert rotation via API (supports rolling key pairs), and endpoints for XML metadata retrieval.
- For OIDC: discovery endpoint (.well-known/openid-configuration), JWKS support, and recommended lifetime defaults for ID/Access tokens.
- IdP-enforced MFA is preserved; Redwood blueprints allow requiring IdP claims (e.g., MFA = true) for session creation.

--- SCIM provisioning
- Supported SCIM endpoint: /scim/v2/ with urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User and Group resources.
- Supported operations: CRUD + Bulk (RFC 7644 bulk) and incremental sync via ETag and startIndex pagination; delta propagation through change logs and /Bulk with patch operations supported.
- Typical throughput: multi-threaded provisioning up to ~500 req/s per dedicated worker node; we can provide performance tuning for large initial imports.
- Attribute mapping: standard attributes + custom attributes via extension schemas. We'll include a sample scim-schema.json (attached).

--- RBAC & Admin Controls
- Role primitives: Owner, Admin, Developer, Observer. Custom role creation is supported with fine-grained permission sets (create, read, update, delete per resource type).
- Delegated admin: tenant-scoped admin roles and delegated admin tokens for scoped operations (no root credentials required).
- Session controls: configurable session timeout, idle-time sign-out, and optional session revocation APIs.
- Just-in-time elevation: Temporary elevation with audit trail (time-limited sudo-ed permissions).

--- Audit / Logging
- Event logging: admin actions, provisioning events, authentication events, model invocations.
- Retention: default 13 months; longer retention available as an add-on. Logs export formats: JSON, CSV, and streaming via webhook/Kafka.
- Real-time hooks: event webhooks and EventBridge/Kafka connectors for near real-time monitoring.

--- Private / VPC differences
- Private deployment (VPC) keeps control plane in customer VPC, with same feature set; audit exports and log storage can be configured to a customer-managed S3/GCS bucket. For fully air-gapped on-prem deployments, SCIM endpoints are local and certificate rotation is managed by the customer's key manager (we provide an HSM/KMS integration pattern).

Notes: We'll include explicit example payloads for SAML metadata, an OIDC discovery doc sample, and a SCIM bulk import example in the pack.

Attachments to include in final pack: horizon-iam-capability-pack.pdf (assembled), scim-schema-sample.json, redwood-sso-setup-guide.pdf

Marissa
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

Quick security checks I verified for the pack:
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II compliant; I'll include the relevant attestation excerpt and security contact.
- Key rotation: We support scheduled rotation and emergency key revocation; for private deployments we document KMS/HSM integration points.
- SCIM provisioning safety: rate-limiting and backoff policies are enforced; bulk imports run as background jobs with auditable job IDs and checkpointing to allow resumes.
- Privacy: user PII mapped in SCIM is configurable; we include guidance for minimal attribute sets during export.

I'm comfortable with the current technical responses — Marissa, please include the SOC 2 attestation snippet and the audit log retention SLA text in the final PDF.

Neha
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
